newsitem.title: MALTA: Yield rates unchanged in Malta bills issue.
newsitem.headline: Yield rates unchanged in Malta bills issue.

text.p: The Malta Treasury on Friday issues Lm 8 million ($22 million) in 28-day treasury bills maturing on November 1.
The weighted average yield rate is 4.99 percent per annum, unchanged from the previous issue of September 20.
The treasury will issue Lm 10.7 million ($29.5 million) in 91-day bills maturing on January 3, 1997, at an average yield of 4.9974 percent, unchanged from the previous issue of September 27.
